description: This Python source file defines application configuration settings for a Flask API, sourcing configuration values from environment variables. It includes a helper function to read environment variables and a dataclass to encapsulate immutable configuration settings, including database connection info, JWT authentication parameters, upload directory, and CORS origins.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: An immutable dataclass that holds configuration for the Flask API, including database connection info, JWT secrets, upload directory paths, content length limits, and CORS origins. It provides a static method to instantiate itself from environment variables.
